title: About GlassFolio
intro: GlassFolio is a personal wealth tracker built in the open: transparent about your money, about its fees and about its own code.

glass.body: Clear visibility on your accounts and on what your fees really cost you, and a codebase anyone can read.

folio.body: One consolidated and unified view of your wealth, across brokers, envelopes and currencies.

story.title: The story
story.p1: GlassFolio is designed and maintained by Damien, an engineering student at ESILV in France. It started from a simple need: following PEA, CTO, crypto and savings accounts in one place, without handing financial data to a third party.
story.p2: It is developed together with advanced AI tools, while applying the standards of professional software engineering at every step.

practices.title: How it is built
practices.intro: The project follows the same discipline as a product team.

tasks.title: Task-based project management
tasks.body: Work is split into epics, sprints and tracked tasks, each linked to the commits that deliver it.

cicd.title: CI/CD
cicd.body: Every push runs six quality gates: types, lint, translations, standards, security tests and the full test suite.

tests.title: Automated tests
tests.body: More than 1,400 automated tests cover the services, the encryption, the tax engine and the interface.

security.title: Rigorous security
security.body: Strict content security policy, pinned dependencies, encrypted vault and hardened container.

delivery.title: Continuous deployment
delivery.body: Every branch gets a preview deployment, and production only ships once the checks are green.
